subject: Upcoming Family Reunion Event Details
body: Dear Family Members, We are excited to announce the details for our upcoming family reunion event! The event will be held on Saturday, August 28th at the local park starting at 11:00 AM. Please bring a dish to share for the potluck lunch. There will be games and activities for all ages, so don't forget to bring your favorite outdoor games. We can't wait to see everyone and catch up with each other. Please RSVP by August 15th. Looking forward to a fun-filled day with our beloved family members!
